Ravi Kumar: quick pass on dark-mode theming after today's deploy — a few spots that need attention.
Elena Torres: ok what's up?
Ravi Kumar: console -> search results. inline code pills (`session_id`) lose definition against list rows. current vars: `--pill-bg: #162026`, `--pill-fg: #94a3b8`. contrast drops on laptop with lower brightness.
Marta Ivanov: also charts: small multiple sparkline fills use three near-blues; when printed in grayscale they collapse.
Elena Torres: for pills we should either lighten fg to ~#c8deff or add a 1px soft outline `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`. prefer outline to keep dark mood.
Ravi Kumar: outline + fg #c7e3ff sounds good.
Marta Ivanov: for sparklines propose using shape differentiation + palette swap: blue (#4aa3ff), amber (#ffb36b), slate-teal (#39c0a8). also ensure stroke >=1px so lines survive compression.
ThemeBot: accessibility-scan v2.0: fails found: pill contrast 3.1:1 (required 4.5:1), sparkline color overlap for deuteranopia. Recommendations: increase pill fg or add border; adopt colorblind-friendly sparkline palette; min 1px stroke.
Elena Torres: let's implement pill outline + fg and replace sparkline palette. Add a feature flag "high-contrast-charts" for customers who want vivid colors.
Marta Ivanov: will prototype and post screenshots. ETA EOD.
Ravi Kumar: thanks, tag @design for quick sign-off once you have previews.
Elena Torres: noted, will follow up.
ThemeBot: change-record: theme-contrast-fix queued for next minor release.
